q: 1. The contract will be awarded to ........
explain: Under public procurement rules, the contract goes to the bidder who is both substantially responsive and has the lowest evaluated bid.

q: 2. Which of the document is prepared and submitted by contractor?
explain: As per the answer key, the contractor prepares and submits the quality assurance plan. The bid document and specifications are prepared by the employer.

q: 3. Which part of contract documents describes the process of performing any items of requirements?
explain: Specifications describe the materials, workmanship and method of performing each item of work.

q: 4. Performance security deposit for the contractor is equal to ........
explain: Performance security is 5% of the contract amount, per the answer key.

q: 5. The abbreviation PWD stands for
explain: In the standard procurement framework context of Nepal, PWD stands for Public Works Directives.

q: 6. The opening of bidding in the process of procurement is known as ........
explain: Inviting and opening bids in procurement is called tendering.

q: 7. For the supply of any goods as per agreement, who is responsible for the all taxed imposed by the GON ........
explain: The supplier bears all taxes imposed by the Government of Nepal under a supply agreement.

q: 8. What is the abbreviation used for German Technical Co-operation?
explain: GTZ (Deutsche Gesellschaft für Technische Zusammenarbeit) was the historical abbreviation for German Technical Cooperation (now GIZ).

q: 9. Which action does not fall under the principle of public procurement
options: procurement should be economic and efficient
procurement should be always be lowest cost
information and equal opportunities to all
explain: Public procurement focuses on 'lowest evaluated substantially responsive bid' rather than blindly picking lowest cost regardless of technical quality.

q: 10. The variation exceeding 15% of the contract amount is approved by
explain: Variations beyond 15% historically require Cabinet/Council of Ministers or higher departmental authority approval specified by law.

q: 11. Who is the Chairperson of Project Co-ordination Committee?
explain: At the district decentralization level, the Chairperson of the District Development Committee (DDC) chairs project coordination meetings.

q: 12. Language of PQ document or notice of international bidding is ........
explain: International bidding documents and notices are issued in English so that foreign bidders can participate.

q: 13. The contractor or consultant are liable to black listing if they are unable to perform as per contract up to ........ years.
explain: Blacklisting for non-performance runs for a period of 1 to 3 years.

q: 14. The bid security shall be forfeited if
options: Bidder withdraws its bid during the period of bid validity specified by the bidder on the Bid form
in case of successful bidder, if the bidder fails within the specified time limit either sign the contract or furnish performance security
explain: Bid security guarantees bid commitment; premature withdrawal or failure to execute contract/performance guarantee leads to forfeiture.

q: 15. For the supply of any goods as per aggrement, who is responsible for the all taxes, duties, licence fees and other such levies imposed by the GoN.
explain: Under standard conditions of contract, all statutory taxes, customs, duties, and levies imposed by GoN are borne by the supplier/contractor.

q: 16. "Corrupt practice" means
options: offering/receiving anything to influence the action of public official
buy more than one bid document
mis representation of facts in order to influence a procurement process
explain: Corrupt practice specifically refers to soliciting, offering, giving, or receiving anything of value to improperly influence official actions.

q: 17. The public procurement regulation is introduced in ........ BS.
explain: The answer key gives 2063. The Public Procurement Act dates from 2063 BS and the Regulation is often cited as 2064 BS, so verify.

q: 18. The bid review committee consists of ........ members.
explain: As per the answer key, the bid review committee has 4 members.

q: 19. Public works must be of very good quality, because:
options: it is paid in higher rate
users are general public and maintenance is not timely difficult and costly
explain: Public works serve the general public, and since maintenance is often delayed, difficult, and costly, high quality construction is essential from the outset.

q: 20. Which of the following mode of selection is related to procurement of goods?
explain: QCBS (Quality and Cost Based Selection) is the mode of selection listed among the options that relates to procurement processes for goods.

q: 21. Prequalification is done
explain: Prequalification (PQ) is executed prior to issuing formal bidding documents to filter eligible, technically capable contractors.

q: 22. The document announcing to prospective bidder that the owner is ready to receive bids is called -
explain: Notice Inviting Bids (NIB) / Notice to Bidders is the formal public advertisement notifying the market of procurement.

q: 23. The time between ordering of the goods or materials and receiving and placing them into use at the point of need is called -
explain: In supply chain management, lead time is the total duration elapsed between order placement and receipt of goods.

q: 24. Bid bond is ........ % of quoted amount.
explain: As per the answer key, the bid bond is 2.5% of the quoted amount.

q: 25. As per the Public Procurement Regulation of Nepal, 2064, What is the maximum remuneration for consulting services that can be procured directly by a public agency?
explain: Direct procurement limit for consulting services under standard PPR rules is up to NRs 500,000 (5 Lakhs).

q: 26. As per the public Procurement Regulation, 2064 of Nepal, what is the maximum weightage for a technical proposal for consulting services ?
explain: Under QCBS evaluation for consultancy services, technical evaluation score weightage is capped up to 80% (with financial at 20%).

q: 27. During construction price variation clause in a contract applies to
options: increase in cost of important materials only
variation in the cost of material labour and fuel
variation in total cost of the project estimated as lump sum figure
explain: Price adjustment accounts for systemic price fluctuations and inflation effects over extended contract periods.

q: 28. The number of members in dispute resolution board is ........
explain: A dispute board can have either 1 or 3 members.

q: 29. For procurement of works up to 2 million, buy which of the following method is to be considered?
options: by direct labour or direct negotiation
explain: Works up to 2 million NRs are procured through simplified competitive sealed quotation/tender methods under procurement rules.

q: 30. The authority of variation order up to 15% lies with ........
explain: As per the answer key, the department head can approve variation orders up to 15%.

q: 31. Procurement of services means:
explain: In the context of the key, option 'd' is specified, while general consultancy/non-consultancy hiring is legally defined under procurement of services.

q: 32. Federation of contractor's association of Nepal is established in ........
explain: As per the answer key, FCAN was established in 1997 AD.

q: 33. If the variation exceeds the 15% of contract amount, then variation order is approved by ........
explain: As per the answer key, variations above 15% need approval from the secretary of the concerned ministry.

q: 34. While procuring the consulting services, RFP is extended to ........
options: all the bidders who submitted EOI
qualified short listed bidders from EOI
explain: After EOI evaluation and short listing, the RFP is sent only to the shortlisted firms.
